newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-SHEFFIELD SHIELD CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES/RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SHEFFIELD SHIELD CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES/RESULTS.

text.p: Results and close of play scores in
four-day Sheffield Shield matches on Sunday.
In Melbourne (final day): Victoria beat New South Wales by
two wickets. New South Wales 290 and 264-8 declared (Rod Davison
In Brisbane (final day): Queensland drew with Western
